params.caption: Ko'pchilik emailni shunday tugatadi: "I look forward to hear from you." Juda tanish, to'g'rimi? Lekin shu gapda kichik tuzoq bor. Look forward to biror narsani intiqlik bilan kutmoq degani. Bu yerdagi to infinitiv emas, oddiy predlog, shuning uchun undan keyin ot yoki -ing shakl keladi: I look forward to hearing from you. We're looking forward to the holidays. She is really looking forward to starting her IELTS course. Oson tekshirish usuli: to'dan keyin "it" qo'yib ko'ring. "I'm looking forward to it" bemalol aytiladi, demak fe'lga -ing qo'shiladi.
